themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and Latin America are leveraging upcoming elections and parliamentary maneuvers to consolidate power. From Vox's final campaign pushes in Spain to Sverigedemokraterna's expanding influence over Swedish government formation, right-wing movements are reshaping electoral strategies and coalition dynamics.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Closes snap election campaign with mass rallies in Valencia, positioning Santiago Abascal as potential kingmaker for a coalition government.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Center Party shifts position, paving the way for a Swedish government heavily reliant on SD parliamentary backing.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Dominates polls as rival parties like BSW openly struggle over how to handle AfD coalition boundaries.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen outlines platform promises and maintains momentum as the leading presidential contender for 2027.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Secures Senate approval to suspend primary elections (PASO) ahead of future legislative and presidential contests.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist campaigns are intensifying demands to restrict immigration and enforce 'national priority' policies. Calls to revoke foreign visas, tighten border security, and curtail public benefits for non-citizens are recurring across multiple national platforms.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Pledges to scrap the graduate visa route for foreign students and eliminate free NHS coverage for non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Focuses final election messages on border defense in Ceuta, national priority in social services, and remigration policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes drastic cuts to immigration spending and foreign aid in its alternative national budget.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Employs sharp rhetoric against immigrant communities and demands stricter national border controls.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders face growing legal scrutiny, party ban threats, and criminal investigations across several countries. In response, right-wing figures are framing these judicial actions as political establishment lawfare and attacking mainstream investigative journalism.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen attacks press freedom and investigative secrecy following leaks regarding Jordan Bardella's alleged past antisemitic posts.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leadership prepares for potential state-level party ban proceedings (Parteiverbotsverfahren) envisioned for 2027.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Legal challenges mount as Flávio Bolsonaro faces scrutiny over his US stay and Mauro Cid receives judicial sentencing terms.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Party leaders clash with prosecutors over Smolensk plane crash findings and ongoing court disputes.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing factions are pushing aggressive fiscal proposals, balancing promises of social benefits with drastic state spending cuts. Factions are proposing massive administrative cutbacks while promising pension increases and tax relief for core constituents.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Meloni promises pension increases across the board for 2027 while rejecting EU budget cuts to Italian agriculture.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Releases an alternative budget proposing 63 billion NOK in cuts to state broadcasting, bureaucracy, and cultural institutions.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Pushes its 2027 budget and central bank reforms through Congress while attempting to curb university spending.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Champions a 'chainsaw' budget reduction plan of 112 billion euros to strip back government administrative spending.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Karol Nawrocki exercises veto power against proposed PIT tax reforms to protect taxpayers.

themes.title: Transnational Conservative Alliances and Bilateral Right-Wing Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right actors are strengthening cross-border networks while engaging in sharp international diplomatic disputes. Nationalist leaders are creating international policy centers while asserting sovereign priority over foreign commitments.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Viktor Orbán launches an international think tank aimed at consolidating European patriotic and nationalist political forces.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni asserts Italian national interests over foreign aid commitments during high-stakes diplomatic talks with Ukraine's president.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Faces diplomatic friction with neighboring Brazil while Javier Milei's economic policies become a key talking point in foreign elections.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Positions itself as part of a wider international conservative coalition, using foreign economic models as focal points in national debates.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Navigates cross-border parliamentary ties with UK allies while establishing a distinct nationalist foreign policy line.
